basic_info.description: Charming and move-in ready Parkside home located directly across from Sunset Reservoir, offering partial ocean views. It's just a couple of blocks from Noriega Street's public transit, shops, and restaurants. Additionally, Taraval Street MUNI lines to downtown San Francisco are just a few blocks away. The top floor boasts a bright and airy west-facing living room with expansive views through the reservoir to Pacific Ocean, an updated eat-in kitchen, a full bath, and two bedrooms side by side in the back. Enjoy the evening sunset while lounging in your living room! Interior stairs lead to an additional bedroom and bath (unwarranted), a one-car garage, and plenty of storage space. The spacious flat backyard is perfect for outdoor lovers. Don't miss one of the few affordable homes in the area!
